title: $K$-Midranks: A robust clustering algorithm for heavy-tailed data with applications to spectroscopy and finance
abstract: arXiv:2611.30953v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clustering data with extreme observations and heavy tails can be challenging for methods that rely on distances between raw observations or specific distributional assumptions. We introduce $K$-midranks, a clustering method that replaces observations with coordinatewise ranks and partitions the transformed data using a procedure analogous to $K$-means. This transformation reduces the influence of extreme values while preserving the ordering of observations within each variable. We evaluate $K$-midranks against $K$-means, $K$-medoids, and mixture models based on Gaussian, Student's t, Cauchy, and generalized hyperbolic distributions through simulation studies, and provide some theoretical properties. $K$-midranks generally outperforms the competing methods on Cauchy-shifted data. translated_title: $K$-中位秩：一种针对重尾数据的鲁棒聚类算法及其在光谱学和金融中的应用
translated_abstract: 对于依赖原始观测值之间距离或特定分布假设的方法而言，对包含极端观测值和重尾分布的数据进行聚类可能具有挑战性。我们提出了 $K$-中位秩（$K$-midranks），这是一种聚类方法，它将观测值替换为逐坐标的秩，并使用类似于 $K$-均值的程序对变换后的数据进行划分。这种变换降低了极端值的影响，同时保留了每个变量内观测值的排序信息。我们通过模拟研究将 $K$-中位秩与 $K$-均值、$K$-中心点以及基于高斯分布、学生t分布、柯西分布和广义双曲分布的混合模型进行了比较，并提供了一些理论性质。$K$-中位秩在柯西平移数据上通常优于竞争方法。相比之下，$K$-均值和基于模型的方法在高斯数据以及三自由度的学生t数据上表现更好。我们展示了该方法在光谱学和金融领域的应用。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 $K$-中位秩的鲁棒聚类算法，通过将观测值替换为逐坐标秩来降低重尾数据中极端值的影响，在柯西型重尾数据上优于传统聚类方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes K-midranks, a robust clustering algorithm that replaces observations with coordinatewise ranks to reduce the influence of extreme values, outperforming traditional clustering methods on heavy-tailed (Cauchy) data.
